topology.summary: RTOR runs on every device. Each peer (Neo, Pixel, Moto, iPhone 17e, and the sites as spaces) is an equal peer, and the mesh is bidirectional: every peer is meant to both send to and receive from every other peer, Neo included. There is no hub and no source device.
